prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop web app redesign composition comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity UI composition mockup for the Korean elementary literacy app “관점 렌즈 사건실” (Perspective Lens Case Room). The screen must make the reading task and evidence comparison unmistakable: a learner reads two fictional narrator accounts, selects sentence evidence, and prepares to explain how position and interest change wording. Treat this as a real accessible web application screen, not a poster.
Structure/composition: case-docket layout with a narrow left index column showing the selected fictional case and a six-stage progress list; the main canvas uses an offset two-column “렌즈 A / 렌즈 B” reading spread, with sentence rows carrying visible numbers and evidence tags. A quiet bottom comparison strip summarizes “공통 사실”, “다른 표현”, and “빠진 정보”, ending in one prominent “근거 보드로 이동” action. Avoid a conventional three-card feature grid.
Use real Korean labels where readable: “관점 렌즈 사건실”, “사건 접수”, “렌즈 A/B”, “근거 보드”, “교차 조사”, “관점 전환”, “사건 보고서”, “관찰 사실”, “인물의 추론”, “평가 표현”, “근거 보드로 이동”.
Identity reference: use the attached existing screenshot only for light paper background, dark ink type, teal and orange annotation colors, compact borders, and clear contrast. Do not copy the screenshot’s exact content or layout.
Style/material: unbleached paper and printed ink, hairline rules, square document tabs, modest radius only for control surfaces, one teal action color plus one orange annotation color, no gradients, no dark mode, no glossy glass, no emoji icons, no photos, no invented brand marks.
Interaction cues: one sentence row is visibly selected with a text label (not color alone), current focus ring is visible on a keyboard control, disabled future steps are explained in plain Korean. Keep all essential touch targets at least 44px.
Quality: polished production UI mockup, crisp Korean typography, readable first-viewport hierarchy, believable responsive web composition, subtle depth without heavy shadows. Avoid poster art, fake statistics, marketing claims, tiny unreadable UI text, purple/blue AI gradients, excessive pill cards, watermarks.
